verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a trust center (SafeBase branding and URL setup, an analytics dashboard) and an API to 'manage your trust center programmatically'. That API is a developer building block, not the platform itself keeping the trust center current. Nothing in the pack documents automatic syncing of subprocessor lists, document renewals, or live control status into the trust center.

support.subject: As an operations lead, the trust center stays current on its own — subprocessor lists, document renewals, and control status update from the platform, not by hand

citations.quote: Automate questionnaires and manage your trust center programmatically.
